data.name: Settings_HidesOverviewMapAndZoom
data.value: Hides the overview map and zoom buttons at the bottom right of the [Script] board. Only the current zoom (e.g. 28%) stays as faint text, and clicking there reaches the writing box underneath.

data.name: Settings_WhenOnHowToHints
data.value: When on, the how-to hints in the Inspector · Speakers · Conditions & stats are hidden, and lines like “No stats yet — type a key in the box below and press [＋ Add]” keep only their first part. Field names, titles and warnings stay.

data.name: Settings_WhenOnWheelOverBoard
data.value: When on, the wheel over the board (two-finger swipe on a touchpad) pans the board, and zooming is Ctrl (⌘ on Mac) + wheel — on a Mac trackpad you can also pinch. When off, the wheel zooms. Dragging with the middle button pans either way. Turn this on if you use a touchpad.

data.name: Settings_ShapeOfNewLinesDrawn
data.value: The shape of new lines drawn on the [Script] board (choice paths · branch lines) — existing lines stay as they are (select a line to change it from the menu on the line). A line's “↺ Auto” also returns to this shape's default.

data.name: Settings_LineSpacingForNewCards
data.value: Line spacing for new cards — a % of the font size (160 means “line spacing 160%” in a word processor). Existing cards stay as they are (change a card's line spacing with the formatting toolbar at the top of [Script]). It stops at the narrowest value for the chosen font and size (the height of one line of Hangul) — going lower would only lower the number, not the screen.

data.name: Settings_FontForNewCardsExisting
data.value: Font for new cards — existing cards stay as they are (change the font of selected text with the formatting toolbar at the top of [Script]).
